business_problem: NOD Games needed a faster way than MySQL to model complex blockchain-game data and launch new games with a very small team.
solution_summary: NOD Games chose MongoDB Atlas on AWS to build blockchain and play-to-earn games without the delays and schema rigidity it faced with MySQL. Atlas became the operational store for player, item, and game data, a much more natural fit for the fluid structures required by NFTs, metaverse features, and rapidly changing gameplay mechanics. The managed platform also gave the five-person team a visual dashboard for cost, performance, and efficiency, reducing time spent on migrations and service construction while preserving 24/7 availability. That let NOD ship a market-ready game in two months with zero downtime, then scale to hundreds of thousands of players and global expansion.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores player, item, and operational game data for NOD Games' blockchain titles.

data_flow: Player, game, and blockchain-related operational data is stored in MongoDB Atlas on AWS, where the small team monitors cost and performance from the Atlas dashboard and serves live gameplay without downtime.
business_outcome: NOD Games launched faster, scaled globally without downtime, and gave its five-person team far more leverage in a new market.
